==Flavor Text==

''Sometimes it feels as if it is looking back at you, equal in its astonishment.''

==About==

A {{i|Curious Cabbage}} received by chance when Harvesting {{i|Cabbage}}. Right-clicking a Curious Cabbage and selecting "Split" will give you 1x {{i|Cabbage Core}} and 6x {{i|Leaf of Green Cabbage}}. Curious Cabbage is a minor [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Cabbage and Kale}} Food Group.
